semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in key materials for integrated circuits, focusing on polishing slurries and surface technology solutions, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Advanced NanoSurface Technologies (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. develops and produces key materials for integrated circuits, with a focus on polishing slurries and surface technology solutions. The company emphasizes independent R&D and large-scale production to serve global semiconductor customers.

regional_presence.China: Headquarters and R&D center in Shenzhen, with a production base and advanced technology research institute in Hefei.
